profiles.name: Hishammuddin Hussein
profiles.description: Hishammuddin Hussein represents Sembrong, Johor, in the Dewan Rakyat. Affiliated with UMNO.
profiles.affiliation_note: The April 2026 confirmed lifting of the UMNO suspension supersedes earlier reports of a continuing suspension. No former ministerial post is shown as current.

profiles.name: Muhammad Islahuddin Abas
profiles.description: Muhammad Islahuddin Abas represents Mersing, Johor, in the Dewan Rakyat. Parliament records affiliation with Perikatan Nasional (PN).

profile_sources.label: PN campaigning and Bersatu suspension · 3 July 2026

profiles.affiliation_note: Parliament’s current PN label is retained. The July report records a Bersatu suspension; campaigning for PN is not proof of an active component-party membership or membership of Wawasan.
